tools.name: search_experts
tools.description: Search approved Callpaymin experts. Categories (industries): Technology, Consulting & Strategy, Marketing & Sales, Wellness & Coaching, Healthcare, Education, Finance & Real Estate, Legal, Entertainment, Retail & E-commerce, Design & Creative, HR & Recruiting, Cybersecurity, Non-Profit, Other. Topic

tools.name: get_expert
tools.description: Public profile, per-minute rate, and scheduling rules for one approved expert. Does not include email or phone.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Industries and topics used by the expert directory.

tools.name: check_expert_online
tools.description: Reads the directory availability flag. It can be up to a minute old and is not a live media presence check.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Public reviews for an approved expert. Reviewer emails are not included.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Count of approved experts currently listed in the directory. Other totals are omitted rather than estimated.

tools.name: get_country_rate_caps
tools.description: Maximum USD per minute an expert in this country may charge. High-income countries and Europe use the higher cap.

tools.name: estimate_call_cost
tools.description: USD estimate from the expert public per-minute rate. This does not book or charge.

tools.name: get_supported_currencies
tools.description: Currencies the Callpaymin wallet charges in. This is not a foreign-exchange table.

tools.name: get_supported_payout_countries
tools.description: Countries shown on the payout settings page, with the rail that page uses (Stripe or Wise). This does not check a live provider, and it does not return bank details.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Wallet balance used to pay for calls. Experts also get withdrawable, pending, and paid earnings. No payout account numbers.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Masked card brand and last four digits saved on the wallet, if any. Full card numbers and vault ids are never returned.

tools.name: disable_auto_recharge
tools.description: Turns off wallet auto-recharge so a saved card is not charged later. Does not charge or debit anything. Does nothing unless confirm=true.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: Cancels an incoming invite you created. A connected call is not ended here, because that cleanup path bills the live session. This tool does not charge or settle. Does nothing unless confirm=true.

tools.name: get_call_session
tools.description: Status of a call invite where you are the caller or the expert. It does not return media credentials or a guessed running cost.

tools.name: create_meeting_room
tools.description: Creates a meeting room through the meetings service for the signed-in expert. maxParticipants is the guest cap, a whole number from 1 to 20. The host is not counted. When omitted, the cap is 20. Does not bill anyone. Does nothing unless confirm=true. An idempotency key replays the same room.

tools.name: list_my_meeting_rooms
tools.description: Meeting rooms hosted by the signed-in expert. Participant emails are not included.

tools.name: list_participants
tools.description: Display names of people in a meeting room you host. Emails and media tokens are not included.

tools.name: close_meeting_room
tools.description: Closes a meeting room the signed-in expert hosts, using the same close path as the website. Does nothing unless confirm=true. Does not charge participants or settle a live billing session. A room with a live billing session must be closed from the meeting screen. Already-closed rooms stay closed.

tools.name: list_my_calls
tools.description: Recent calls where the signed-in user is the caller or the expert. Amounts are that user's cost or earnings. Recordings are not included. At most 40 recent calls are scanned.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Receipt for one of your calls. Other people's calls are not found. Recording URLs are not included.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: The signed-in user's own profile fields.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Updates your own public profile fields. Email, role, balance, and payout data cannot be changed here.

tools.name: update_rate
tools.description: Sets your public USD per-minute rate, capped by country. Without confirm=true this only previews the cap. To save it, pass confirm=true and acknowledgedAmountUsd equal to perMinute.

tools.name: set_availability
tools.description: Sets the directory availability flag other people see: online, offline, or busy.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Your expert application status. Approval is a profile field. Every account can use the consumer tools.

tools.name: get_earnings_summary
tools.description: Current pending, releasable, and paid expert earnings. A custom period is not applied; figures are the live totals, not an estimate for that window.

tools.name: get_releasable_balance
tools.description: Expert earnings past the 7-day hold that are available to withdraw. This does not request a payout.

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.description: Your payout requests: id, amount, status, and provider. Bank account numbers are not included.

tools.name: get_payout_methods
tools.description: Saved payout destinations: id, provider, country, and last four digits. Full account numbers are not returned.

tools.name: favorite_expert
tools.description: Saves an approved expert on your account.

tools.name: unfavorite_expert
tools.description: Removes an expert from your favorites.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: Experts you have favorited.

tools.name: get_referral_code
tools.description: Your own referral code, if one has been issued. Commission is 5% for 12 months from the first paid payout of a referred expert. Referred people are on get_referral_stats.

tools.name: get_referral_stats
tools.description: People who used your code, as a name or initials, the date they joined, and whether the referral is still active. Emails and account ids are not included.

tools.name: apply_referral_code
tools.description: Links your account to a referrer. Does nothing unless confirm=true. Uses the existing referral linker.

tools.name: get_rate_coach_suggestion
tools.description: Compares your rate with your country cap and the median public rate of up to 20 listed experts in your industry. It is a hint, not a required price.

tools.name: get_deep_link
tools.description: Builds a Callpaymin URL for a known page. It does not sign the link or embed a token.

tools.name: get_expert_availability
tools.description: Open booking slots for an expert on a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: Bookings where the signed-in user is the quester or the expert. Defaults to upcoming bookings.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Quotes a scheduled call. Without confirm=true this only returns the price. With confirm=true and acknowledgedCostUsd equal to estimatedCostUsd, it holds the slot as pending_payment for 20 minutes and returns a callpaymin.io link to pay on the website. It never charges a card or debits the wallet.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Cancels a booking you are part of. Does nothing unless confirm=true. Other people's bookings are not found.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Active jobs on the public board. Poster emails, invite codes, and draft or pending jobs are omitted.

tools.name: list_my_jobs
tools.description: Jobs posted by the signed-in user, including ones still waiting for review. Invite links are omitted. Applied jobs are not listed, because applications are stored on the poster account.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Creates a job in pending_review, the same hold the website uses before an admin approves it. It is not added to the public board. Does nothing unless confirm=true, and then requires an idempotency key. The invite link is returned once.

tools.name: respond_to_job
tools.description: Applies the signed-in user to an active public job using the same application record as the website. Does nothing unless confirm=true. Cannot apply to your own job or to a job that is not active. Applying does not charge credits or fees.

tools.name: close_job
tools.description: Removes a job posted by the signed-in user. close, withdraw, and delete are the same removal the website Delete button performs, including a job still in pending_review: the job document is removed, the public listing is removed, and an audit snapshot is kept. Does not charge or refund anyone. Does

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: No foreign-exchange rate source is configured. Wallet charges are USD, and this tool will not invent a rate. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Consumer chat billing, including the first 10 free messages, is tied to the chat product session and is not wired to MCP. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sending a message can be billed after the free allowance. The chat writer is not wired to MCP, so no message is stored. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: get_chat_summary
tools.description: AI chat recaps are produced by the chat summary service for organization sessions, not as a consumer-thread tool. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: join_meeting_room
tools.description: Joining a room needs a mediasoup WebRTC client. MCP cannot open that media path or start meeting billing. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: list_my_chats
tools.description: Consumer chat threads are not exposed through a user-scoped query that is safe to return from MCP yet. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: set_do_not_disturb
tools.description: The call router does not read a do-not-disturb window. Setting one here would not change who can reach you. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: clear_do_not_disturb
tools.description: The call router does not read a do-not-disturb window, so there is nothing to clear. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Expert applications go through the signup flow, including document upload and review email. MCP will not mark an application submitted. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: get_tax_docs
tools.description: Tax documents are not generated by an API this server can read. Nothing is returned in their place. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: rate_call
tools.description: Reviews are submitted by the post-call review API, which checks that you were on the call. That check is not wired here, so no review is stored. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: mute_participant
tools.description: Mute is a mediasoup host command. MCP cannot reach the media server, so nobody is muted. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: toggle_recording
tools.description: Recording is controlled by the meeting room service. MCP does not start or stop a recording. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: send_support_ticket
tools.description: There is no support-desk API in this app. MCP will not pretend a ticket was filed. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

tools.name: get_support_ticket
tools.description: There is no support-desk API in this app. This tool is not yet supported. Nothing is read or changed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_call_session" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Status of a call invite where you are the caller or the expert. It does not return media credentials or a guessed running cost.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_expert, get_reviews, list_my_meeting_rooms, list_participants, get_receipt, get_referral_stats, get_deep_link, list_jobs, list_my_jobs, start_chat, send_message, get_chat_summary, list_my_chats, submit_application, rate_call, send_support_ticket, get_support_ticket · Private data: get_supported_currencies, get_wallet_balance, get_payment_methods, disable_auto_recharge, get_call_session, list_participants, get_deep_link, create_booking, respond_to_job, close_job, convert_currency, submit_application, get_tax_docs · Public sink: get_expert, update_profile, post_job, send_message, submit_application, rate_call, send_support_ticket · Destructive: close_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_expert, get_reviews, list_my_meeting_rooms, list_participants, get_receipt, get_referral_stats, get_deep_link, list_jobs, list_my_jobs, start_chat, send_message, get_chat_summary, list_my_chats, submit_application, rate_call, send_support_ticket, get_support_ticket · Private data: get_supported_currencies, get_wallet_balance, get_payment_methods, disable_auto_recharge, get_call_session, list_participants, get_deep_link, create_booking, respond_to_job, close_job, convert_currency, submit_application, get_tax_docs · Public sink: get_expert, update_profile, post_job, send_message, submit_application, rate_call, send_support_ticket · Destructive: close_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
